newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures rise on sterling weakness.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures rise on sterling weakness.

text.p: LIFFE wheat futures rose on sterling's weakness against other European currencies, traders said.
Active May wheat last traded up 1.75 stg at 95..00 stg on volume of 200 lots. The biggest rise was for July, last traded 2.10 stg higher at 96.90 stg on volume of 55 lots.
Barley futures also rose. Active May rose 0.50 stg to last trade at 92.50 stg. There were 63 lots of May traded, compared with total barley volume of 104 lots.
